mapper.select: SELECT SERIE, CHNR, ACT, BU, REASON, REGISTER_DATETIME AS registerDatetime, REGISTER_USER AS registerUser, REGISTER_PROCESS AS registerProcess, UPDATE_DATETIME AS updateDatetime, UPDATE_USER AS updateUser, UPDATE_PROCESS AS updateProcess FROM HDOC_ADCA_CHANGE WHERE SERIE = #{serie} AND CHNR = #{chnr}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO HDOC_ADCA_CHANGE (SERIE, CHNR, ACT, BU, REASON, REGISTER_DATETIME, REGISTER_USER, REGISTER_PROCESS, UPDATE_DATETIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_PROCESS) VALUES (#{serie}, #{chnr}, #{act}, #{bu}, #{reason}, NOW(), #{currentUser}, 'UD16ADChangeApi', NOW(), #{currentUser}, 'UD16ADChangeApi')
mapper.update: UPDATE HDOC_ADCA_CHANGE SET ACT = 'N', UPDATE_DATETIME = NOW(), UPDATE_USER = #{currentUser}, UPDATE_PROCESS = 'UD16UpdateHdocAdcaChange'
